note: Committed-secret gate allowlist (Echelon Wave 8). Each entry excuses ONE exact hit — path + pattern + SHA-256 of the matched value — with the reason it is not a live secret. A different value at the same path still fails the gate. If a real secret is ever committed: rotate it and purge it; never allowlist it (see docs/CI_GATES.md).
